================================================================================
C CODE COMPILED IN BY THE PG_QUERY CRATE

The pg_query crate builds libpg_query from source and links it statically into
the vericto-proxy binary. libpg_query contains parts of the PostgreSQL parser and
vendors protobuf-c and xxHash. cargo-about only sees the crate's own license
(MIT), so these notices are kept here and appended by build-notices.sh. The
crate's MIT notice is repeated below with its copyright lines, which the crate
package does not include.

Refresh this file when pg_query changes version: the image build stops if the
version below does not match Cargo.lock.

pg_query version: 6.2.0
